name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
summary: Rahauro sends you from Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise into Ragefire Chasm. Magatha Grimtotem seeks her lost emissary Maur and the unusual discovery he made among the troggs.

sections.title: A Grimtotem Mission Beneath Orgrimmar
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem hears on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise that her emissary, Maur Grimtotem, entered the cavern beneath Orgrimmar to study the troggs and try to parley with them. He never returned, and rumors say he found something unusual shortly before his death. While Warchief Thrall and his advisers focus on the Shadow Council presence in Ragefire Chasm, the Grimtotem clan follows its own interests.

sections.title: The Fallen Emissary
sections.body: Rahauro, Magatha Grimtotem’s attendant, sends warriors into Ragefire Chasm on her behalf. Deep in the lava-filled tunnels, Maur’s battered body lies near the trogg encampments. Crude clubs and bare fists killed him, but the troggs left his belongings untouched. His satchel and whatever secrets he sought remain for Magatha’s agents to recover.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers on this quest?
aliases: who starts searching for the lost satchel
faq.answer: Rahauro, Magatha Grimtotem’s attendant on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise, sends you into Ragefire Chasm.
Maur Grimtotem was Magatha’s emissary. He entered Ragefire Chasm to study the troggs and try to communicate with them, but they beat him to death in the cavern depths.

faq.q: Why was Magatha Grimtotem interested in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Magatha was interested in the troggs beneath Orgrimmar and sent Maur to try to communicate with them. After he discovered something unusual among them, she wanted his discovery brought to her.

faq.q: Where is Maur Grimtotem's corpse located?
faq.answer: Maur’s body lies deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, near the trogg territories along the underground paths.

faq.q: Did the troggs loot Maur after killing him?
faq.answer: No. The troggs left Maur’s clothing and satchel beside his battered remains.

faq.q: What happens after locating Maur's body?
faq.answer: Finding Maur’s body leads to the next step, Returning the Lost Satchel. You take his satchel to Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff with his findings.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may find Magatha’s curiosity about creatures beneath an allied city worth watching. The Grimtotem clan’s aims often differ sharply from Cairne Bloodhoof’s open leadership.
As a member of the Horde, you see Thrall focused on dark cultists beneath the capital while the Grimtotem pursue their own quiet goals in the same cavern.
